summary: Tested the proxy-vote feature, where player 1 enters the banishment vote of an absent player, on the backend and frontend (390x844, plus two phones). Backend: 69/69 pytest pass. This includes the new test_proxy_vote.py (9 tests) and the updated test_skip_vote.py (new 403 message) and test_traitors_game.py (proxy_by field). Frontend: every requested flow works. Away? opens away-sheet with Enter/Skip. The vote list excludes the absent player (4 options). A wrong PIN or another player's PIN shows away-sheet-error. P1's PIN shows 'Vote entered by TEST_P1' with an Undo button. Undo shows 'Remove TEST_P3's vote?' and needs P1's PIN. Skip shows 'Not voting today · skipped by TEST_P1'. P1's own row goes straight to the skip PIN. Cancel and tapping the background close the sheet, and reopening starts fresh. The reveal tally counts the proxied vote (P4 3, P2 1). History shows 'Vote entered for: TEST_P3 (by TEST_P1)'. Two phones: a proxy on phone A showed on phone B after 2.3s, and an undo on B cleared on A after 0.8s. How to play and the setup note mention the feature. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: If by_id or pin is missing from the body, Pydantic returns 422 (required fields), not the friendly 400 from auth_host. The app always sends both, so this is harmless.

issues: Away? and Undo buttons are 79x40 (below 44pt). hitSlop=6 brings the tap area up to about 52, so this is acceptable, but minHeight 44 would be cleaner.
On the PIN step after picking a vote there is no Back button to change the pick. The only way out is Cancel, which restarts the flow.
'Vote entered by TEST_P1' wraps onto 2 lines on 390px when the name is long. It is still readable.

action_items: Optional: add a Back button on the away-sheet PIN step in proxy mode so you can change the vote pick.
Optional: give the skipBtn (Away?/Undo) style minHeight 44.
critical_code_review_comments: proxy_vote checks are correct: phase check, then auth_host (403/401), alive check, no proxying for yourself, already voted ('turns_done and not skipped and not proxied'), target validation. You can re-proxy (change the vote) without counting the turn twice.
take_turn pops proxied, so the absent player's own vote replaces the proxy. Undo through /skip clears the vote, the turn and proxy_by. advance resets proxied on both day->roundtable and reveal->day.
A proxied Traitor does not set murder_confirmed or next_target (verified), which keeps roles secret as intended.
seed_data_creation: UI game BZMT3 (5 TEST_P players, PINs 0001-0005) was created through ui_seed.py and deleted afterwards. Pytest fixtures deleted their games.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. test_proxy_vote.py reuses helpers from test_skip_vote.py (proxy() helper). To get a UI game: python ui_seed.py create, then setup <code>, then POST /advance twice to reach the Round Table. The PIN pad uses testIDs pin-key-0..9. The frontend always sends by_id=host_id, so another player's PIN shows 'Incorrect PIN' (401), not 403.
